beats.say: GTA 6: Rockstar's union vote coincides with launch.
PC Gamer says the vote runs from 12 to 26 November, around the game's launch on 19 November.
If it passes, the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union becomes the UK's biggest game industry union.
Rockstar head Jennifer Kolbe indicated they will not fight a union.
Over fourteen days, Rockstar workers decide their future while the world plays GTA 6.
